input.query: SELECT variant, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN margin_60d_eur END) AS margin_per_converted_user, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN bonus_cost_eur END) AS incentive_per_converted_user, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN first_topup_amount END) AS avg_first_topup_amount FROM fct_experiment_users WHERE experiment_id='topup10_2026q1' GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant
